name: Giselle
established_facts: In the prologue of the narrative, Giselle, an artist who is deaf, paints in her small room while a feast prepares outside

She perceives the world through color instead of sound, interpreting the dynamics of her surroundings through vibrant hues that represent the emotions and personalities of those she observes
